sources.name: Morning Brew on X (link from Mahir)

caption:
Nvidia's board met late on Wednesday, November 11, to decide whether to remove CEO Jensen Huang, Reuters reported. The Wall Street Journal said the board was preparing to oust him.
Huang admitted an affair with a woman US officials believe is a Chinese spy. The New York Times reported a second affair, with Nvidia executive Kimberly Powell.
Nvidia shares fell more than 8% after hours. Semafor reported some directors favor CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO. No decision had been announced as of Thursday morning.

Can Nvidia keep winning without Jensen Huang?
